Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine
Namespace OneStream.BusinessRule.Finance.MTCH_DataClear_Arc Public Class MainClass
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal args As FinanceRulesArgs) As Object Try Select Case api.FunctionType Case FinanceFunctionType.CustomCalculate If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("ClearMetrics") Then ClearMetrics(si, api, api.Pov.Origin.Name) ElseIf args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("ClearAllo") Then ClearAllo(si, api, api.Pov.Origin.Name) 'ARC - Lucas Negro - MATCH-363 - Creating Sequence to execute clear for all data ElseIf args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("ClearAll") Then ClearAll(si, api) Else BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc - Unsupported Function Name: " & args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName) End If End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
Private Shared Sub ClearAll(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi) Try ClearMetrics(si, api,"Import") ClearMetrics(si, api,"Forms")
ClearAllo(si, api, "Import") ClearAllo(si, api, "Forms")
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Sub
Private Shared Sub ClearMetrics(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal originName As String) Try Dim metricAccounts As New List(Of String) From { "2021_Original_Hire_Grant_SBC", "2022_Annual_Grant_Award_SBC", "2023_Annual_Grant_Market_Based_Award_SBC", "2023_Original_Hire_Performance_Based_H_Award_SBC", "2023_Performance_Based_E_Award_SBC" }
For Each acct As String In metricAccounts Dim filterScript As String = BuildMetricsFilterScript(api, acct, originName)
BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc ClearMetrics - Filter Script: " & filterScript)
ClearStoredDataFromFilter(si, api, filterScript) Next
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Sub
Private Shared Sub ClearAllo(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal originName As String) Try Dim filterScript As String = BuildAlloFilterScript(api, originName)
BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc ClearAllo - Filter Script: " & filterScript)
ClearStoredDataFromFilter(si, api, filterScript)
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Sub
'ByOrigin - In Function call Private Shared Function BuildMetricsFilterScript(ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal accountName As String, ByVal originName As String) As String Dim parts As New List(Of String)
'AddExactIfPresent(parts, "O", api.Pov.Origin.Name) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "O", originName)
parts.Add("A#" & accountName) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "F", api.Pov.Flow.Name) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "I", api.Pov.IC.Name)
AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U1", api.Pov.UD1.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U2", api.Pov.UD2.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U3", api.Pov.UD3.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U4", api.Pov.UD4.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U5", api.Pov.UD5.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U6", api.Pov.UD6.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U7", api.Pov.UD7.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U8", api.Pov.UD8.Name)
Return BuildFilterMembersScript(parts) End Function
Private Shared Function BuildAlloFilterScript(ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal originName As String) As String Dim parts As New List(Of String)
'AddExactIfPresent(parts, "O", api.Pov.Origin.Name) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "O", originName)
AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "A", api.Pov.Account.Name) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "F", api.Pov.Flow.Name) AddExactIfPresent(parts, "I", api.Pov.IC.Name)
AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U1", api.Pov.UD1.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U2", api.Pov.UD2.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U3", api.Pov.UD3.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U4", api.Pov.UD4.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U5", api.Pov.UD5.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U6", api.Pov.UD6.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U7", api.Pov.UD7.Name) AddExpandedIfPresent(parts, "U8", api.Pov.UD8.Name)
Return BuildFilterMembersScript(parts) End Function
Private Shared Sub ClearStoredDataFromFilter(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal filterScript As String) Try Dim clearDestination As ExpressionDestinationInfo = api.Data.GetExpressionDestinationInfo("") Dim sourceBufferToClear As DataBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula(filterScript, DataApiScriptMethodType.Calculate, False, clearDestination)
If sourceBufferToClear Is Nothing Then BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc - Source buffer is Nothing. Nothing to clear.") Exit Sub End If
If sourceBufferToClear.DataBufferCells Is Nothing Then BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc - Source buffer cell collection is Nothing. Nothing to clear.") Exit Sub End If
If sourceBufferToClear.DataBufferCells.Count = 0 Then BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc - Source buffer returned 0 cells. Nothing to clear.") Exit Sub End If
Dim resultBufferToClear As New DataBuffer()
For Each sourceCell As DataBufferCell In sourceBufferToClear.DataBufferCells.Values Dim clearCell As New DataBufferCell(sourceCell) clearCell.CellAmount = 0D clearCell.CellStatus = DataCellStatus.CreateDataCellStatus(True, False) resultBufferToClear.SetCell(si, clearCell) Next
api.Data.SetDataBuffer(resultBufferToClear, clearDestination)
BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "MTCH_DataClear_Arc - Cleared cells count: " & sourceBufferToClear.DataBufferCells.Count.ToString())
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Sub
Private Shared Function BuildFilterMembersScript(ByVal parts As List(Of String)) As String Dim sb As New StringBuilder() sb.Append("FilterMembers(") sb.Append(String.Join(", ", parts.ToArray())) sb.Append(")") Return sb.ToString() End Function
Private Shared Sub AddExactIfPresent(ByVal parts As List(Of String), ByVal dimPrefix As String, ByVal memberName As String) If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(memberName) Then Exit Sub parts.Add(dimPrefix & "#" & memberName) End Sub
Private Shared Sub AddExpandedIfPresent(ByVal parts As List(Of String), ByVal dimPrefix As String, ByVal memberName As String) If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(memberName) Then Exit Sub parts.Add(GetExpandedMemberScript(dimPrefix, memberName)) End Sub
Private Shared Function GetExpandedMemberScript(ByVal dimPrefix As String, ByVal memberName As String) As String If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(memberName) Then Return "" End If
If memberName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("None") Then Return dimPrefix & "#None" End If
If memberName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("Top") Then Return dimPrefix & "#Top" End If
Return dimPrefix & "#" & memberName & ".Base" End Function
End Class End Namespace
